text:
eli: Partner PoC hit duplicate side-effects with Python async SDK + function/tool calling + structured outputs. Emails sent twice.

eli: Short repro (from partner):
```py
from redwood import AsyncClient
import os, uuid, asyncio

client = AsyncClient(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_KEY'))

async def main():
    invocation_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
    resp = await client.chat.create(
        model='rwd-1-3b',
        messages=[{'role':'user','content':'Send signup email to alice@example.com'}],
        tools=[{
            'name': 'send_email',
            'parameters': {'to':'string','subject':'string','body':'string'},
            'metadata': {'invocation_id': invocation_id},
            'returns': 'application/json'
        }],
        function_call='auto'
    )
    print(resp.id)

asyncio.run(main())
```

eli: Network traces show two POSTs with different request ids but identical tool.metadata.invocation_id. Server emitted two function_invoke events.

zoe: Any 5xx or auth refresh? That would explain a retry.

omar: Partner logs show the client retried after a response stream timeout. First request reached runtime and triggered the tool; client timed out waiting for full response and retried.

lina: Two fixes: (A) add client-generated idempotency key and send as x-invocation-id for server dedupe; (B) change retry behavior so automatic retries are suppressed once a tool decision is observed.

zoe: Short-term: update sample app to generate invocation_id and include it in tool metadata; teach SDK to forward metadata.invocation_id as x-invocation-id header when present. Also add README note to disable retries for side-effecting tools.

omar: Long-term: infra should dedupe invocations by header/body field. I'll open a ticket.

eli: I'll open a GH issue and PR with the sample-app patch and a partner mitigation guide.

ci-bot: created ticket 10321 (sdk: toolcall idempotency) and linked eng-runtime.

lina: Also add a unit test asserting header presence and a log line when a retry is suppressed due to tool_call decision.

eli: Thanks all — will post PR link when ready.
